texts.preamble: Vrindaban Group Of Companies vs The Chief Financial Officer on 23 October, 2025 Author: Sanjeeb K Panigrahi Bench: Sanjeeb K Panigrahi In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack W.P.(C) No. 28109 of 2025 Vrindaban Group of Companies, Cuttack ........ Peti Mr. Chitta Ranjan Pat -Versus- The Chief Financial Officer Idfc First Bank Ltd. & Ors. ....... Opposite P Mr. Ramachandra Panigra Coram: Dr. Justice Sanjeeb K Panigrahi Order 23.10.2025 Order No. 02. 1 . This matter is taken up through hybrid arrangement.
texts.facts: And further may issue a Writ of mandamus directing the Opp. Party No.2 to de-freeze his account vide account no.10233809943 in the name of Vrindaban Enterprises , forthwith preferably within a stipulated period as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper. The said above works have been undertaken through IDFC Bank, Janpath Branch, Bhubaneswar.
texts.arguments: And may pass any such other order/orders, direction/directions which this Hon'ble Vrindaban Group Of Companies vs The Chief Financial Officer on 23 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169770127/ 1 court may deem lit and proper." 4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner's company known as Vrindaban Enterprises has undertaken various business model comprising procurement and supply of organic farms fresh products, civil supply contracts, transportation services, digital sales, spices, flour, fresh, preserved fruits, vegetables and other related food products. 5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further contends that the Branch Manager, IDFC Bank, Bhubaneswar without any reason has freezed the Petitioner's account bearing A/c. No. 10233809943 for which the Petitioner could not operate its account. He further submits that the Petitioner has made a representation before the Bank to defreeze its account. In response, the Bank has sent a reply to the Petitioner through email stating that its account has been freezed as a precautionary measure to ensure its safety and certain transactions observed in its account did not appear to align with the profile information. Hence, the Petitioner is constrained to approach this Court.
